title: Home-Site Lease Late Fee Terms
content:
**Late fee terms of the Home-Site Lease**

1. *When a late fee may be assessed.* A late fee may be assessed only after the grace period for that billing period has ended, counted from the due date of that billing period's rent charge. The due date is the date of that period's rent charge on the rent ledger, and the fee is tied to that rent charge. The boundary is exclusive: no late fee may be posted on the last day of the grace period itself.
2. *Grace counting — no longer in force.* The former clause counting the grace period in calendar days from the day after the due date, so that the fee could be posted no earlier than the calendar day after the due date plus the lot class's grace days, is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis for the length of the late-fee grace period.
3. *Amount — no longer in force.* The former clause setting the fee at the lot class's late-fee percentage of the period's rent and occupant charges still unpaid at the end of the last grace day, raised to the lot class's minimum and capped at its maximum, is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis for working out the late fee. The lot class's late-fee minimum and maximum themselves remain the lot class's figures.
4. *When no fee is charged.* No late fee is charged when the period's unpaid amount is zero; none is charged on fees, deposits or prior late fees; and at most one late fee is charged per billing period.
5. *On-time payment.* A payment counts as on time when its entry date is on or before the last grace day, whatever the channel.
6. *Repayment agreements.* No late fee is charged for a billing period covered by a repayment agreement whose installments are current.

**Clauses 4 to 6 as points of judgement**

| Situation on the ledger | Late fee for the period |
|---|---|
| Nothing of the period's rent and occupant charges remains unpaid | none |
| A late fee has already been charged for the period | no second fee |
| The only unpaid items are fees, a deposit or an earlier late fee | none on those items |
| The payment's entry date is the last grace day, made by any channel | the payment is on time |
| The period is covered by a repayment agreement with installments current | none |

**Clause 1 at its boundary (hypothetical last grace day "G")**: on day G no late fee may be posted; from the day after G a late fee may be assessed if the conditions of the current basis are met.

superseded_clauses: The fee is late_fee_pct_of_unpaid_rent percent of the period's rent and occupant charges still unpaid at the end of the last grace day (lease_msr_period_rent_unpaid), raised to late_fee_minimum and capped at late_fee_maximum for the lot class, rounded half up to the cent.
The grace period is counted in calendar days starting the day after the due date, so the fee may be posted no earlier than the calendar day after the due date plus late_fee_grace_days.
